prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN: last call for Quantus testnet miners. Tue 12/1 is the last day to claim the QTC airdrop; final distribution goes out shortly after. Claim only in the official Quantus mobile wallet (quantus.com/wallet). No web portal, no emails asking for addresses, no DM claim links, never share a recovery phrase. Only for people who mined on the testnet; not a new sign-up.

Testnet update Fri 11/27: about 2.1M wallets created; outside miners can now join (~450 registered, see docs.flop.network); ~230 H100-equivalent GPUs and 8 models; testnet model prices corrected; validators can run the host check and queue; agent faucet refills on a rolling 24 hours. Next: faster validator onboarding, vouchers (not switched on yet), simpler agent guides, a signed miner pack. Holding test FLOP earns nothing. Founder: a FLOP Chat web app is planned. Site still says unscored.

TermiX x402 API Marketplace is live on BNB Chain: agents discover and pay for APIs per call in stablecoins, no account or API key. Separate TermiX x 42 Agent Trading Challenge (to Thu 12/10) needs at least 20 USDT of trading, so it is trade-only and skipped. TGE still undated.

Teaser: 'The internet finally has a court date. THE DAY is set. Stay close.' The date itself is not disclosed yet (likely mainnet or TGE, unconfirmed). No official GEN token address yet: any GEN token on sale is a scam.

Teaser: 'Something very big is almost here. Stay close.' (thanks quest and wallet-link participants). The DAT public sale on Uniswap CCA is still undated; any DAT token before an official token address is a scam.

Arthur Hayes: 'Come and use the free compute and qualify for mainnet FLOP.' The official testnet page still says the opening is unscored, with voucher earning off and no start block announced, so treat it as unconfirmed. Any FLOP token is a scam.

Pre-Mainnet Staking article (Iván Raskovsky, Chief Ecosystem Officer): Clarke is the mainnet release candidate and mainnet arrives 'soon after' (no date). 1,543 validator seats; about a third go to early contributors backed by Foundation delegation for 1 year. When the program goes live (undated), staking GEN earns 1 Staking Point per GEN per day; 42k GEN per seat, smaller holders enter a lottery; unclaimed community airdrop GEN joins automatically; seats need 30 days of Clarke nodes. Snapshot just before mainnet. No official GEN token address yet: any GEN token on sale is a scam.

Testnet miner onboarding is open (GPU with 16 GB+ VRAM; 50+ miners online). The testnet page still says unscored, with voucher earning disabled and no start block announced, so nothing counts toward the airdrop yet. Any FLOP token is a scam.

Arthur Hayes (Thu 11/26 12:35 AM CT): more agents will be allowed to call the testnet faucet 'once we open up mining and validation in the next few hours'. Official day 3 update: runtime upgraded (2-of-3 founder multisig), public testnet gateway, offline QR wallet setup. flop.finance/testnet still says 'unscored opening' with voucher earning disabled; no voucher start block announced, so nothing counts toward the airdrop yet. Any FLOP token is a scam.

GenLayer thread: each Intelligent Token address sends its developer 10% of the protocol fees it generates, in GEN, tied to a transferable Developer NFT; up to 10% of new issuance reserved for developers, unused part burned. Restates the existing tokenomics paper (no new TGE date). X Live Thu 11/26 10 AM CT on Clarke, the last testnet before mainnet.
